notes: The minifigure (page 2 and final step) is not in the official parts list, so it is not modelled.
The pictures are small and low-resolution, so exact stud-to-stud ports were left null. Which brick sits on which is my best reading.

The 87611 bottom and 87615 top fuselage pieces are modelled as joined to each other. The 3 black round boat-stud plates (step 10) are attached to the 87611 piece. The manual's views of this area are ambiguous.
The red 2x2 plate (302221) is not clearly shown in the steps. I placed it on the red fuselage top (step 9).
The two yellow grille tiles on the motor are each attached to one of the side studs of the 1x2 side-stud brick.
The motor clip (63868) clips onto the bar of the white handle brick (30236) in step 14. It is modelled as revolute.
The 52501 piece is shown only as a single piece in step 1 and is attached to the 60219.
